title: Self-thermoregulating current collectors: built-in thermal protection for safe lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3177-3185
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04896B, Paper
Yitong Peng, Tao Meng, Pingan Li, Rongxin Li, Xianluo Hu
A thermal-responsive phase change composite current collector provides self-actuated overheating protection for lithium-ion batteries, suppressing rapid temperature increases and preventing localized hot spots, thus improving battery safety.
